blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Rank counts only communities with at least ten homes listed. Falling listings with steady sales mean homes are being absorbed faster; rising listings with steady sales mean more choice for buyers. A sellers’ best bet is a community where homes sell quickly against the number listed; a buyers’ best bet is the reverse. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Between June 2026 and September 2026, detached houses: listings held at 137, and it took 14.5% of the city’s 351 sales over the period; condos and townhomes: listings went from 143 to 136, and it took 11.7% of the city’s 591 sales over the period.
The monthly write-ups singled out Fleetwood Tynehead for condos and townhomes in August (a sellers’ best bet); condos and townhomes in July (a buyers’ best bet).

faq.q: Are there more or fewer homes for sale in Fleetwood Tynehead than in June?
faq.a: Between June 2026 and September 2026, listings of houses held at 137 and condos and townhomes fell from 143 to 136 in Fleetwood Tynehead.

faq.q: How big is Fleetwood Tynehead compared with the rest of Surrey?
faq.a: In September 2026, Fleetwood Tynehead held 12.2% of the 1,120 houses listed in Surrey and 8.9% of the 1,523 condos and townhomes listed in Surrey.

faq.q: How many homes sold in Fleetwood Tynehead from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 51 houses and 69 condos and townhomes sold in Fleetwood Tynehead over those 4 months.

faq.a: School catchments are set by address, so use the school district's catchment locator with the exact address. Catchment lines change, so check before you write an offer.
